query_document_question_answering: query the Hugging Face inference API with an image and question to get document question answering results
encode_image_base64: encode an image file to base64 for inclusion in a Hugging Face inference API payload
build_hf_inference_headers: build authorization headers for Hugging Face inference API requests using an HF_TOKEN environment variable
post_payload_to_hf_api: post a JSON payload to the Hugging Face inference API and return the JSON response
run_document_qa_with_layoutlm: run document question answering using the impira/layoutlm-invoices model on a Hugging Face inference endpoint
